about: The mutant ledger of runtime/explore/sched (wf10 X6): edits the package's properties, the worker guard in runtime/v1 (tag ergoexplore) or cmd/ergo's TestReplayTestChecks must kill. scripts/mutants judges only check and lower today; a unit that changes these files applies each edit by hand and runs its killers (the X6 runner: /tmp/opencode/x6/mut.ts, recorded in the round request).

mutants.name: x6-push-push-independent
mutants.rule: Two pushes to one queue are dependent: their order shows in the pops.

mutants.name: x6-sleep-across-dependent
mutants.rule: A sleeping task wakes when the step taken is dependent with its step.

mutants.name: x6-preempts-not-reset
mutants.from: d.n, d.preempts, d.drained, d.blocked, d.diverged = 0, 0, false, false, ""
mutants.to: d.n, d.drained, d.blocked, d.diverged = 0, false, false, ""
mutants.rule: The preemption count starts at 0 for each schedule.

mutants.name: x6-sleep-under-bound
mutants.rule: A bounded search keeps no sleep sets: the orders that put a task to sleep may lie past the bound.

mutants.name: x6-pct-change-unapplied
mutants.rule: At a change point the task at the point drops to priority d-i.

mutants.name: x6-replay-goes-on
mutants.from: return 0, fmt.Errorf("the run left the schedule at step %d: task %s is not enabled; enabled: %s", c.Step, want, names(c))
mutants.rule: A replay that leaves its schedule stops the run.

mutants.name: x6-schedule-by-order
mutants.rule: A printed schedule names each picked task by its spawn path, not by its place among the enabled tasks.

mutants.name: x6-table-row-missing
mutants.rule: The dependency table has a row for every rt.OpKind.

mutants.name: x6-pool-keeps-abandoned
mutants.rule: A run that left a task ends its worker.

mutants.name: x6-pool-worker-per-run
mutants.rule: A worker whose runs ended clean is reused: at most one worker more than the abandoned runs.

mutants.name: x6-worker-deadlock-kept
mutants.from: o.Abandoned = res.Escape != "" || res.Stopped != nil || res.Deadlock != nil
mutants.rule: A deadlocked run leaves its tasks parked: its worker serves no more runs.

mutants.name: x6-replay-test-unquoted
mutants.rule: The printed test's schedule is an Ergo []string literal.

mutants.name: x6-replay-test-offset
mutants.rule: The printed schedule is relative to the failing test: the root's children of earlier tests do not count.

mutants.name: x8-replay-drops-run
mutants.rule: The replay command of a failure under --run NAME keeps --run NAME.

mutants.name: x8-replay-token-unquoted
mutants.rule: The replay command quotes the schedule token: its stars are glob characters to a shell.

mutants.name: x8-replay-test-ignores-run
mutants.rule: Under --run NAME the printed failing test is NAME, even when the run stopped before any verdict line.

mutants.name: x8-words-ignore-names
mutants.to: if name, ok := names[s.Handle]; ok && false {
mutants.rule: Words print a handle by the name the run gave it.
